notes.title: Regular Update: Feb '24
notes.content: In short: added costumes that unlock through random events when you reach a decent popularity level, added a zoomable ID card, added the option to play your next run with the character you last completed the game as, added a new title screen.

notes.title: The Yuuuuuge Update
notes.content:
Greetings game enjoyers,

Today marks one of Loser's Romance's biggest updates yet. 

Keller the ginger holy roller is now befriendable/dateable. 

There are more music tracks, specifically ones that play during longer conversations. 

You now gain popularity levels, which change how some characters treat you.

The goals and perks screens have been improved, with filters and titles. 

More costumes are available on the perks screen.

More goals, too.

New/improved/more sound effects have been added, as well as little UI animations when you give a gift or buy something at the store.

Aaaaand the game's price will be going up to $9.99 to reflect its improved size and quality. 

Expect more updates regularly as we move forward, and thanks for reading!

notes.title: A Quick Update
notes.content:
Polished the UI and improved a few graphics.
Tinkered with the store page.
Added the option to randomize your character if you choose the quickstart ("skip intro") after your first playthrough. Now you can jump right back in for another run.

notes.title: The Carrie Update
notes.content:
This month brings an entire new friendship/romance option. That's Carrie Farr, your popularity-obsessed classmate and local donut clerk. Also, bugs have been fixed, artwork tweaked, and more variant lines added. 

Stay tuned for the next big updates, which should add another couple characters. In the future, there'll also be male options, making Loser's Romance officially an otome game. (Look it up, non-weebs.)

Thanks, all!

notes.title: Latest Update: QoL Additions, Variant Lines
notes.content:
Today, Loser's Romance gets "resistance bars." These are drained as you break down a new friend's defenses. As a quality of life update, they'll make it easier to gauge your progress.

(They're basically health bars, but I don't want to make it sound like you're beating your new friends' asses.)

Also added are more variant lines at the grocery store-- the stuff gamers crave.

notes.title: The "What an Update!" Update
notes.content:
Hello again, Fake High Schoolers (still the official name for Loser's Romance players until someone- quite reasonably- objects).

With tonight's unprecedented update, Loser's Romance is no longer just an elevated dating sim with light puzzle elements, but the world's best (only) roguelike high school sim with elevated dating and puzzle elements. This update adds:

...the ability to earn scholar dollars (your school's fakey, neon reward money) for accomplishing certain tricky goals. Trade scholar dollars in to unlock a bevy of gameplay enhancements, fun cosmetics including goth costumes, and secrets.
"Recoveries" to protect you from social gaffes. They're also needed to unlock...
Best friendship endings. Instead of becoming a boyfriend/girlfriend/themfriend, become someone's best friend by sticking with and supporting them.
Marriage endings. Achieve the best outcome on the hardest difficulty and you and your gal will be together forever in downwardly mobile wedded bliss.
Easy and normal difficulty now offer a "boring normie" answer to certain choices. It's low risk, but low reward.
An expanded UI tracks recoveries, your grade point average, and who/whether you're dating.
Additional achievements help track your progress.

notes.title: Coming Soon: The "What an Update!" Update
notes.content:
Greetings Fake High Schoolers! (That's the new Official name for Loser's Romance players. Or not.)

I've been working day in and out to add several huge new features and story paths:


As of next update, you'll be able to earn scholar dollars (your school's fakey, neon reward money) for accomplishing certain goals. Trade scholar dollars in to unlock a bevy of gameplay enhancements, fun cosmetics, and secrets. 

You'll be able to get recoveries, which protect you from social gaffes. They'll also be needed to unlock...

Best friendship endings. Instead of becoming a boyfriend/girlfriend/themfriend, you'll soon be able to become someone's best friend by sticking with and supporting them.

Easy/normal difficulty will offer a "boring normie" answer to certain choices. It's low risk, but low reward. 

I'm tweaking the UI visuals, once again refining the entire script, and improving a few sprites.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43077668/d58fa6af1ef753afa589e869f5e0eaa6f7d48d78.png

With Loser's Romance expanding its scope from "comedy dating sim" to "comedy roguelike high school sim (with dating)," the near future will see a price increase. I recommend picking LR up while it's still dirt cheap.

notes.title: Regular Update - Winter Holiday Week
notes.content:
The store page for Loser's Romance has been updated with all new screenshots reflecting the new and improved backgrounds.

As for the IN-GAME grocery store, it's stocking a new holiday item: a menorah, AKA the Jewish candle holder famously associated with Hanukkah. As always, everyone you can gift it to has a unique reaction. 

With the winter sale coming up tomorrow, this is the perfect time to purchase and try out Loser's Romance if you haven't yet.

Happy holidays, everyone!

notes.title: Regular Update: Portraits and a New Mechanic
notes.content:
The senior portraits unlocked through each character's best ending have been touched up to look extra nice.
A new mechanic now allows players to explore/date around more and still get a decent ending. If you reach one of the romantic interests' endgame (Character A), if another one (Character B) knows and likes you, you can now transfer over some of that affection. That is, if Character A gives a crap about the opinion of Character B. This mechanic encourages exploration whereas it was previously punished by opportunity loss, and should make the game that much more fun and welcoming.

notes.title: Regular Update #4
notes.content:
All backgrounds have been polished and refinished as line art, improving their look.
A new, animated main menu has replaced the old, static one. 

More soon to come!

notes.title: Try (Watching) Before You Buy / Another Regular Update
notes.content:
Wow! These characters I drew for self-promotion are SO excited to deliver some cool news. 

https://i.ibb.co/pzwNZNv/update-art.png

Hiko, an awesome Vtuber, has done a playthrough of Loser's Romance. If you're on the fence about buying LR, definitely check it out to see if the game clicks with your sense of humor:

https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1658949027?t=00h08m26s 
(Link expires in two weeks)

Today also brings a small update:


Loren, Jr., has a new shirt design so you can tell right away he's a proud(?) Panel Galaxy employee.
The end-of-date, September, and October choices now describe what happens when you choose them. These are points where the player should be making decisions, not guesses.
Additional notes may now show up during the "finding a note in the trash" event. The new notes, from a friendly dimbulb, help you cheat on the quizzes. 
 
Thanks for reading! More is always on the way.

notes.title: Regular Update #3b
notes.content:
Now once you beat the game, you'll unlock a "skip intro" option. "Skip intro" mode cuts to the essential choice points during the first in-game month, which will fly by while still making sense narratively. With this quick way to jump in, replaying the game should feel a lot better. 
An optional hard difficulty has been added if you really want a challenge.

notes.title: Regular Update #3
notes.content: A number of backgrounds have been enhanced and improved. More to come!

notes.title: Regular Update #2b
notes.content:
This mini-update adds an optional easier difficulty and improves controller support.

As well as planning bigger content for the future, I'm currently working on implementing a fast forward mode, which will unlock once you beat the game once.

notes.title: Regular Update #2
notes.content:
This week, we're adding:


An animated background for the name entry and menu screens.
Spruced up "student ID" and "Carrie" sprites.
A couple new locations where you might see an event at school.
Three new items in the store.


Stay tuned for the next regular update as Loser's Romance continues to expand.

notes.title: Regular Update #1
notes.content: Five new items have appeared at Cruller's Grocery. They'll enter the random rotation of purchasable items whenever you visit the store. As always, each item has a unique reaction from every character.

notes.title: Release Day Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. Thanks for playing/wishlisting!

I've just uploaded a patch to iron out some release day kinks. Please update and enjoy.
